spans.title: The Monk's Cough
spans.blurb: Alone for her first night in a strange grand house, a girl hears coughing from a room the maid swears is empty, and learns the legend behind it.

spans.title: Left Behind
spans.blurb: Two jealous cousins slip away by night to strand their prettier cousin at home, certain she is too timid to travel alone. Then a stranger knocks.

books.pairNote: The journey scheme and the first night ghost legend are separate scenes with no shared text or shared payoff.

spans.title: The Sleeper's Many Faces
spans.blurb: Deep in a rotting damp house, a young man keeps the night watch while his sleeping uncle drifts into dreams that do not seem to be his own.
spans.spoilerNote: The dream of a choking, possessing presence hints at the danger that later closes over the sleeping uncle in the full story.

spans.title: The Secret Benefactor
spans.blurb: A breezy American walks into a shabby weekly's office with an odd proposition: send a young writer to Switzerland in style, and never tell her who paid.

spans.title: Bound in the Stolen Ship
spans.blurb: A pilot wakes tied hand and foot aboard his own stolen spacecraft, while the terrified thief at the controls flees glowing serpents that strip ships bare.

spans.title: The Apples of Derketa
spans.blurb: Treed on a crag by a monster no blade can pierce, a barbarian lashes three sticks, a dagger, and poisoned fruit into one last weapon.

spans.title: A High Pink Finish
spans.blurb: At a hotel manicure table, a big spender in diamonds lays on the flattery while a sharp young manicurist files, parries, and weighs his dinner invitation.

spans.title: The Building With No Door
spans.blurb: In a lonely valley, a father and son blast their way into a sealed, humming building that has been doing something strange to the sunlight.

spans.title: The Story of the Humpback
spans.blurb: A merry humpback chokes at a tailor's supper, and his corpse begins a midnight journey from house to house as each new host panics.
spans.brokenNote: It opens and closes mid-sentence, ending on a clipped word with the chain of blame still hanging unresolved.

spans.title: The Question at Free Trade Hall
spans.blurb: Two young women bring one small banner and one question to a packed political meeting, and refuse to sit down until somebody answers it.

spans.title: The Girl on the Embankment
spans.blurb: Walking home late along a canal, a hopelessly shy dreamer hears a stranger crying at the railing, and chance hands him his first real conversation with a woman.
